snippet.title: UNFROST - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
UNFROST is a co-op Antarctic horror FPS for 1–4 players.

Your mission is to hunt a creature that conventional weapons cannot kill. Investigate anomalies, gather evidence, uncover its weakness, and prepare the nuclear strike capable of destroying it.

Every expedition is a race against the cold, the anomalies, and a creature already hunting your squad. There are no fully scripted boss encounters — every hunt unfolds differently depending on the evidence you find, the decisions you make, and how well your team works together.

We’re a small indie team, and we’ve been working on UNFROST for quite a while. Today, we’re incredibly excited to finally reveal it to the world.

Wishlist UNFROST on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3377450/UNFROST/

And let us know what you think. It truly means a lot to us.
